title: Unfolded distillation: very low-cost magic state preparation for biased-noise qubits
conversion_notes: Paper says its Stim simulations replace each intended X^(1/4) rotation by X^(1/2); change the specific proxy rotations to R_X(0.25) (or H T H, checking sign and rotation convention). Do not replace unrelated square-root X operations. Reassess detector and postselection semantics for the non-Clifford circuit.
notes: Author repository explicitly identifies repetition-code and surface-code simulation folders and a Toffoli bottom-up scheme. Paper confirms Stim proxy; exact source locations of rotation instructions were not verified. Protocol unfolds 15-to-1 Reed-Muller distillation into a 2D physical circuit.

title: SymFT: Universal Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuit Simulation via Symbolic Clifford--Pauli Frames and Stabilizer Coordinates
conversion_notes: No Clifford proxy conversion required; benchmark README describes distillation.stim as an extended Stim-like file with non-Clifford gates. Check rotation angle units (half-turns) and simulator dialect compatibility.
notes: README identifies 85-qubit [[17,1,5]] distillation workload, used with Tsim and Clifft. README states this file family contains T, T_DAG, R_X or R_Z; individual operations in distillation.stim were not independently inspected. It is not parseable by ordinary Stim.

title: Clifft: Fast Exact Simulation of Near-Clifford Quantum Circuits
conversion_notes: Inspect qec_bench/distillation_bench and its inputs before use; the benchmark workspace is explicitly listed but the precise circuit source and gate contents were not independently verified.
notes: Paper authors' benchmark repository lists distillation_bench. Clifft's current documentation additionally describes 1,037 noiseless triorthogonal circuits collected by Matthew Cha; their public artifact location and association with this paper's original benchmark remain unverified.

title: Magic state cultivation: growing T states as cheap as CNOT gates
conversion_notes: Cultivation generators have S/Y-basis proxy variants. Replace only identified injection/cultivation stand-ins with corresponding T or T_DAG, preserving signs and feedback; actual factory surgery scripts require careful interpretation and may not be generated physical Stim circuits.
notes: Repository identifies testdata/surgery_scripts as diagrams of magic-state distillation factories, and provides Stim generation for injection/cultivation. The diagrams are a possible factory-circuit starting point, not verified as complete non-Clifford distillation generators.

title: Magic State Distillation: Not as Costly as You Think
conversion_notes: Reconstruct circuit-level rotations from definitions.py and protocol descriptions, then export to extended Stim; no direct Stim circuit generation was confirmed.
notes: Author supplementary repository is resource-cost code, not verified Stim. It explicitly lists onelevel15to1.py, twolevel15to1.py, twolevel20to4.py and twolevel8toCCZ.py, making this a reconstructable lead rather than a direct circuit release.

title: Experimental Demonstration of Logical Magic State Distillation
authors: Sales Rodriguez, Robinson, Jepsen, et al.
conversion_notes: QuEra tutorial directly builds a noisy five-to-one circuit with T/T_DAG and rotations, and an 85-qubit [[17,1,5]] encoded version using Bloqade Circuit/Tsim; export to the extended Stim dialect. It is a related implementation, not verified to be the paper authors' original released circuit.
notes: The tutorial and SymFT benchmark are independently released implementations of related encoded five-to-one distillation. The paper describes a Stim-based Clifford channel simulation; a release of its own exact simulation code was not verified.
